name: Mud Monarchs
subtitle: Architects of a False World Order
goal: Bury Tartaria's legacy forever to preserve their crumbling rule.
philosophy: If the masses ever learn what lies buried beneath them, the world order they spent centuries building collapses. Better that history forget Tartaria entirely.
structure: Descended from Tartaria's noble class. Operate through global elites, intelligence networks, assassins, and aging Aetheric machines.
joinRequirements: Bloodline ties, demonstrated loyalty to suppression, willingness to silence rediscoverers.
flavor: You keep what your ancestors took. The world will not remember Tartaria if you have anything to say about it — and you have everything to say. The throne is crumbling, but it is still a throne.

name: Forgotten Order
subtitle: Seekers of the Lost Truth
goal: Recover Tartaria's Aetheric knowledge and rebuild the world with it.
philosophy: Aether is humanity's birthright. Buried, it festers; revealed and mastered, it saves us.
structure: Descendants of Tartaria's engineers and scholars. Operate from hidden enclaves like Varakush, conducting clandestine expeditions.
joinRequirements: Demonstrated scholarship, recovery of a Tartarian artifact, or referral by an existing member.
flavor: Knowledge was meant to be lit, not buried. You dig because the world above is dying of forgetting, and the only cure is in the mud. You have a notebook, a lamp, and a long way to walk.

name: Reclaimers Guild
subtitle: Opportunists of the Lost World
goal: Profit. Whoever pays best gets the relic.
philosophy: Tartaria is a goldmine. We don't ask what the buyer wants it for.
structure: Loose coalition of scavengers, mercenaries, and treasure hunters. Black-market network with brokers in every major city.
joinRequirements: A relic worth selling, or a contract delivered without complaint.
flavor: Whoever pays best gets the relic. Ideology is a tax other people pay. The Guild has brokers in every city and grudges in none of them. You bring the haul, they handle the rest.

name: True Tartarians
subtitle: Survivors of the Subterranean World
goal: Reclaim the surface and restore Tartaria's empire.
philosophy: We are the rightful heirs. The surface forgot; we remembered.
structure: Subterranean enclaves beneath buried cities. Aethercraft adepts. Worship the Tartarian Giants as divine.
joinRequirements: Mud Dweller heritage or demonstrated devotion to the old empire.
flavor: The surface forgot. You didn't. Every tunnel you carve is a road home; every relic you find is a stone returned to its rightful wall. When the Giants wake, you will already be marching.

name: Eternal Dynasty
subtitle: The Aetherborn Cabal
goal: Reactivate Tartaria's Aetheric cores and rule the world through the Aetherborn bloodline.
philosophy: The fall of Tartaria was a cleansing test. Only the pure deserve to inherit.
structure: Secretive aristocracy of Aetherborn descendants. Bred, trained, and tested in hidden estates. Some are sacrificed to power their machines.
joinRequirements: Aetherborn blood, demonstrated power, and passing the Dynasty's tests of purity.
flavor: The fall was a culling. The survivors were the test. The next empire is yours by blood — provided your blood is purer than the others' and you can prove it. The Dynasty does not flinch at what it asks.

name: Conspiracy Architects
subtitle: Controllers of the False Narrative
goal: Keep the Unknowing Masses ignorant of Tartaria and Etheric technology by any means necessary.
philosophy: Knowledge of Tartaria would destabilize global society. The lie is a kindness. The silence is a service.
structure: A covert cabal embedded in global media, academia, and intelligence networks. Aligned with and largely funded by the Mud Monarchs.
joinRequirements: Demonstrated ability to suppress information and evidence. An existing member's vouchsafe.
flavor: Truth is the most expensive substance on Earth and you are its merchant. You sell silence by the page, by the city, by the century. The lie is a kindness. The silence is a service. Nobody thanks you, and nobody is supposed to.

name: Servants of the Giants
subtitle: Devoted to the Sleeping Titans
goal: Awaken the Tartarian Giants and restore the empire through their divine power.
philosophy: The Giants did not fall. They wait. When they rise, Tartaria rises with them.
structure: A religious faction conducting rituals and pilgrimages at Tartarian ruins. Loosely affiliated with the True Tartarians but more fervent and less political.
joinRequirements: Demonstrated faith and willingness to participate in ritual expeditions to Tartarian ruins.
flavor: Faith asks one question — when they wake, will you be ready? You will. The Giants did not fall; they only laid down. Every ritual you walk, every ruin you visit, you are telling them you remember.

name: Stone Builders
subtitle: Scholars of the Sacred Architecture
goal: Understand and replicate Architectural Sorcery — the Tartarian fusion of engineering and Aetheric principles.
philosophy: Tartaria's buildings were scripture in stone. Study them long enough and they will teach us to build a better world.
structure: A hybrid religious-scientific order with lodges near major Tartarian ruins. Share scholarly findings selectively. Cooperate with the Forgotten Order on engineering questions.
joinRequirements: Demonstrated knowledge of Tartarian architectural principles or Aetheric engineering. Submission of original research.
flavor: Every Tartarian wall is a sentence and you can almost read them. You take notes by lamplight in chambers no surface scholar will ever see. The lodge knows you. The world above does not. Yet.

name: Tartarian Revivalists
subtitle: Restore Tartaria at Any Cost
goal: Reactivate Tartaria's Etheric Power systems and fully restore the empire, even at the risk of a Second Mud Flood.
philosophy: Every other faction tinkers at the edges. We are the only ones willing to do what actually needs to be done.
structure: Led by Sasha Ironheart. Decentralized cells that share a goal but not always methods. Regarded as extremists by most other factions.
joinRequirements: Absolute commitment to Tartaria's revival. Willingness to act where others hesitate.
flavor: Half measures are how empires die. You will turn the engine back on, second mud flood be damned. Sasha Ironheart will not ask you to be careful. She will ask you to be brave.
